summary: This document specifies how to encode Multipoint LDP (mLDP) Forwarding Equivalence Classes in the NLRI of BGP MCAST-VPN routes. This supports multicast in BGP/MPLS IP VPN services when mLDP provides the provider tunnels.

eli5.summary: Providers carry customers' group broadcasts across their network. This document defines the exact format of the note that tells the network which tunnel to use.
